exams.name: GitHub Actions
exams.blurb: GitHub certification on automating workflows with GitHub Actions, covering workflow syntax, runners, secrets, reusable workflows and deployments.

exams.name: GitHub Administration
exams.blurb: GitHub certification on administering organisations and enterprises, covering authentication, policies, licensing, migrations and repository governance.

exams.name: GitHub Advanced Security
exams.blurb: GitHub certification covering code scanning with CodeQL, secret scanning, dependency review and integrating security into developer workflows.

exams.name: GitHub Copilot
exams.blurb: GitHub certification on using and administering GitHub Copilot, covering prompt techniques, developer workflows, privacy and responsible AI use.

exams.name: GitHub Foundations
exams.blurb: Entry-level GitHub certification covering repositories, branching, pull requests, GitHub Flow, issues, projects and collaboration fundamentals.
